root_cause_summary: Frozen checksum is SHA256(X.parquet bytes || y.parquet bytes) produced by freeze_dataset_cohort_v1_2.cache_raw writing raw y (bool for kc1). Confirmatory download path load_openml_raw casts y to category before cache_raw_openml, producing different y.parquet bytes (842835c7...) despite identical semantic content. On-disk 1067 cache was written by loader path during failed campaign; validation reads existing parquets without rewrite.
other_datasets_loader_style_risk: 1067-only for bool y; category targets (44,1489,46921 tested) produce identical freeze/loader byte checksums
recommended_remediation: Replace byte-level raw checksum validation with canonical-content identity check for ALL frozen datasets; re-materialize 1067 parquets using freeze-identical writer after canonical hash verification
